```go
import "github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex"
```

Package tlogindex implements the encodings of a verifiable index committed into a C2SP tiled transparency log: per\-key value logs, the binary Merkle Patricia Trie \(MPT\) that maps each key to its value log root, binary MPT inclusion and non\-inclusion proofs, and the index state entry that commits an MPT root into the indexed log itself.

The value log, MPT node hashing, key padding and binary proof step encodings follow the "Index Structure", "Binary MPT proofs" and "Verifying an MPT path" sections of the C2SP tlog\-vindex specification \(https://github.com/transparency-dev/incubator/blob/main/vindex/docs/tlog-vindex.md\), unchanged, so any tlog\-vindex auditor recomputes the same roots:

```
value_log_leaf_hash(idx)        = SHA-256(0x00 || uint64_be(idx))
value_log_node_hash(l, r)       = SHA-256(0x01 || l || r)
mpt_leaf_hash(key, value_root)  = SHA-256(0x00 || uvarint(len(key)) || key || uvarint(32) || value_root)
mpt_inner_hash(b, left, right)  = SHA-256(0x01 || uvarint(b) || left || right)
empty_mpt_hash                  = SHA-256("")
proof step                      = uvarint(b) || sibling_hash
```

The state entry is the one part that is specific to DNSid: the index is committed into the log it indexes rather than into a separate output log, so the entry carries only the indexed size, the input root at that size and the MPT root. Its line layout follows the tlog\-vindex state entry so the two can converge. See [StateEntry](<#StateEntry>).

This package holds pure encodings and has no network or log\-format dependencies; the DNSid mapping function and bundle verification live in the parent c2sptlog package.

## Constants

<a name="HashSize"></a>

```go
const (
    // HashSize is the size of every hash in the index: SHA-256.
    HashSize = sha256.Size
    // MaxKeyLen is the longest canonical key, in bytes.
    MaxKeyLen = 1024
    // MaxSplitBit is the largest split bit two distinct canonical keys can
    // have: the first bit of the 0x00 terminator after a 1024-byte key.
    MaxSplitBit = 8 * MaxKeyLen
)
```

<a name="StateEntryHeader"></a>StateEntryHeader is the first line of an index state entry.

```go
const StateEntryHeader = "dnsid.org/tlog-index-state@v1"
```


<a name="VerifyNonInclusion"></a>
## func [VerifyNonInclusion](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex/proof.go#L117>)

```go
func VerifyNonInclusion(root Hash, key string, proof []byte) error
```

VerifyNonInclusion verifies that key is absent from root. For the empty trie the proof must be empty. Otherwise the proof names the terminal leaf reached by key's bits; it is accepted only if that leaf's key differs from key, agrees with key at every split bit on the path, and hashes up to root.

<a name="ValueRoot"></a>
### func [ValueRoot](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex/valuelog.go#L26>)

```go
func ValueRoot(indices []uint64) (Hash, error)
```

ValueRoot returns a key's value log root: the RFC 6962 Merkle Tree Hash over leaves uint64\_be\(idx\) for each entry index in indices. indices must be non\-empty and strictly increasing, because a key with no occurrences is absent from the MPT rather than mapped to an empty value log.

<a name="MapFunc"></a>
## type [MapFunc](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex/replay.go#L12>)

MapFunc is a deterministic mapping function from one raw log entry to the canonical key it is indexed under. ok is false when the entry maps to no key. A non\-nil error aborts indexing: the index cannot be computed past an entry the mapping function cannot classify.

```go
type MapFunc func(entry []byte) (key string, ok bool, err error)
```

<a name="ProofStep"></a>
## type [ProofStep](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex/proof.go#L10-L13>)

ProofStep is one decoded binary MPT path step: an inner node's split bit and the hash of the sibling subtree at that split.

```go
    Sibling Hash
```

<a name="ParseProofSteps"></a>
### func [ParseProofSteps](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex/proof.go#L20>)

```go
func ParseProofSteps(data []byte) ([]ProofStep, error)
```

ParseProofSteps decodes a sequence of path steps, uvarint\(b\) || sib\_hash, ordered from the leaf up to the root. It enforces the spec's decoder rules: every uvarint is minimal and at most 10 bytes, every split bit is at most 8192, split bits strictly decrease, every sibling hash is a full 32 bytes, and no bytes trail the last step.

<a name="StateEntry"></a>
## type [StateEntry](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex/state.go#L36-L40>)

StateEntry is an index state commitment appended to the indexed log. It commits the MPT root over the keys mapped from entries \[0, InputSize\) and the RFC 6962 root of the log at InputSize. Its exact text form is four newline\-terminated lines:

```
dnsid.org/tlog-index-state@v1
input-size <decimal InputSize>
input-root <base64 InputRoot>
mpt-root <base64 MPTRoot>
```

The decimal has no sign and no leading zeros \("0" for zero\). The base64 is standard RFC 4648 Section 4 base64 with "=" padding, matching the tlog\-vindex conventions; encoders produce canonical base64 and the parser rejects any non\-canonical encoding. There is no carriage return, no trailing whitespace and nothing after the fourth newline. The index start is always 0, so unlike the tlog\-vindex state entry there is no "from" line, and the input log origin is implied by the log the entry is in.

```go
type StateEntry struct {
    InputSize uint64
    InputRoot Hash
    MPTRoot   Hash
}
```

<a name="Trie"></a>
## type [Trie](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex/mpt.go#L42-L45>)

Trie is an immutable binary Merkle Patricia Trie over canonical keys, built in one pass from the full key set. The zero value is not usable; build one with NewTrie.

```go
type Trie struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewTrie"></a>
### func [NewTrie](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex/mpt.go#L52>)

```go
func NewTrie(values map[string]Hash) (*Trie, error)
```

NewTrie builds the MPT over values, a map from canonical key to value log root. It sorts the keys once and builds the trie in O\(n\) from the split bits of adjacent keys, which the spec's topology rule makes equivalent to inserting the keys one at a time in any order. It returns an error wrapping ErrInvalidKey if any key is not canonical.

<a name="Trie.ProveInclusion"></a>
### func \(\*Trie\) [ProveInclusion](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex/mpt.go#L159>)

```go
func (t *Trie) ProveInclusion(key string) ([]byte, error)
```

ProveInclusion returns the binary MPT proof that key is present: the path steps from key's leaf to the root, without the key and value. A trie with one key has an empty inclusion proof.

<a name="Trie.ProveNonInclusion"></a>
### func \(\*Trie\) [ProveNonInclusion](<https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-go/blob/main/log/c2sptlog/tlogindex/mpt.go#L174>)

```go
func (t *Trie) ProveNonInclusion(key string) ([]byte, error)
```

ProveNonInclusion returns the binary MPT proof that key is absent: the terminal leaf reached by walking key's bits, encoded as uvarint\(len\(path\_key\)\) || path\_key || uvarint\(32\) || path\_val, followed by that leaf's path steps. An empty trie has an empty proof.
